shortDescription: Move data between LVM Physical Volumes (PVs)

options.name: atomic
options.description: Makes the C(pvmove) operation atomic, ensuring that all affected LVs are moved to the destination PV, or none are if the operation is aborted.

options.name: auto_answer
options.description: Answer yes to all prompts automatically.

options.name: autobackup
options.description: Automatically backup metadata before changes (strongly advised!).

options.name: destination
options.description: Path to the destination block device to move data to. Must be an existing PV with enough free space.

options.name: source
options.description: Path to the source block device to move data from. Must be an existing PV.
